additional_info.subject: ID0411968-DC/Si-D/MC[WeABTr] - Connector availability toggling CRM:00315002434
additional_info.body:
Hi Yan, good afternoon.
Could you please kindly help us to have a better understanding of the root cause?
The root cause is that when there is a disconnection from the SECC for 4.25sec, you will see the outlet out of order. It recovers after a few seconds but still there is a negative impact.
What was the initial issue?
The initial issue is that you are seeing “Unavailable” in the your backend due to a communication timeout with the SECC (charging controller).
What has changed in the new software release?
Increase of timeout of disconnection
What are you hotfixing into it?
The hotfix is only applicable in the v6.0.3 or v6.1.3 since it's already been tested for these versions, as they are the latest available. So, in order to have the hotfix without any issue, we always require these one of the two versions.
I rechecked the error rate after the hotfix and so far, there has been no occurrences, I installed it at 15:13 CET yesterday.
As I mentioned, I will proactively check if there was any occurrences and report back. Let me know if you understood my answers.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
